note: The English that stays English in this package's browser half, one entry per literal, each with the reason it is not copy. The self-check (test/toolbar-copy.spec.mjs, reading T5) scans src/client/** for copy and every such finding must be covered here; an entry whose anchor is not in the tree fails too, and every id is named in README.md. An entry carried by `key` names a dictionary key whose zh and en values are byte-identical on purpose (reading T8): the value is a product name or an identifier, never an untranslated sentence.
